title: Synthesis and Anticancer Evaluation of O-Alkylated (E)-Chalcone Derivatives: A Focus on Estrogen Receptor Inhibition.
authors: Al-Ghamdi, Alwah R; Ahmed, Wahid U; Al-Wabli, Reem I; Al-Mutairi, Maha S; Rahman, A F M Motiur
one_liner_zh: 该文研究查尔酮衍生物的合成与抗癌活性，涉及EGFR等激酶抑制和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cancer remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, highlighting the urgent need for novel therapeutic agents. This study investigated the synthesis and biological evaluation of O-alkyl (E)-chalcone derivatives (4a-4v) as potential anticancer agents. The compounds were synthesized via aldol condensation of substituted aldehydes and acetophenones, with structures confirmed by IR, NMR, and mass spectrometry. In vitro cytotoxicity assays revealed varying effectiveness, with compounds 4a, 4b, 4q, and 4v exhibiting potent activity against MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7, showing IC(50) values between 2.08 and 13.58 microM, besides HCT-116 and HeLa cancer cell lines (IC(50) values between 6.59 and 22.64 microM). Notably, compound 4b displayed remarkable selectivity, with an IC(50) of 54.59 microM against the non-cancerous WI-38 cell line. Additionally, protein kinase inhibition assays indicated that compounds 4b and 4q effectively inhibited EGFR and VEGFR-2, with 4b outperforming the standard inhibitor erlotinib. Molecular docking studies of compound 4q showed strong binding affinities in the ATP-binding pockets of EGFR, HER2, VEGFR2, and CDK2. In silico analyses further highlighted the favorable pharmacokinetic properties of compound 4q, underscoring its potential as a selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor. These findings suggest the therapeutic promise of O-alkyl (E)-chalcone derivatives in cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 癌症仍然是全球发病率和死亡率的主要原因，凸显了对新型治疗药物的迫切需求。本研究探讨了O-烷基（E）-查尔酮衍生物（4a-4v）作为潜在抗癌药物的合成及生物学评价。这些化合物通过取代醛和苯乙酮的羟醛缩合反应合成，其结构经IR、NMR和质谱确认。体外细胞毒性实验显示其有效性各异，其中化合物4a、4b、4q和4v对MDA-MB-231和MCF-7表现出强效活性，IC(50)值介于2.08至13.58微摩尔之间，此外对HCT-116和HeLa癌细胞系也有效（IC(50)值介于6.59至22.64微摩尔之间）。值得注意的是，化合物4b表现出显著的选择性，对非癌性WI-38细胞系的IC(50)为54.59微摩尔。此外，蛋白激酶抑制实验表明，化合物4b和4q有效抑制EGFR和VEGFR-2，其中4b优于标准抑制剂厄洛替尼。化合物4q的分子对接研究显示其在EGFR、HER2、VEGFR2和CDK2的ATP结合口袋中具有强结合亲和力。计算机模拟分析进一步突显了化合物4q良好的药代动力学特性，强调了其作为选择性酪氨酸激酶抑制剂的潜力。这些发现表明O-烷基（E）-查尔酮衍生物在癌症治疗中的治疗前景。
